About the Farmer

Grown with care, harvested with pride

Murugan Farms is a small family-owned farm in Udayanandhal Village, Thenmathur Post, Tiruvannamalai District, Tamil Nadu. G. Murugan and M. Santhi have been cultivating various crops for many years with a focus on natural and healthy farming practices. Our goal is to provide fresh, quality farm products directly to families and local customers.

  • Seasonal crop planning suited to the TN-25 region
  • Natural cultivation with minimal chemical input
  • Direct farm-to-home supply for local families

— G. Murugan & M. Santhi
